name: achievement_badges
description: Five matching cozy garden achievement medallions: 1) completion, a gold star on a sky-blue ceramic center; 2) bird finding, a small blue feather on a peach ceramic center; 3) mastery, a brass magnifying glass over a cream center; 4) progression, a tiny painted-wood trail sign with an upward leaf; 5) streak, a warm golden sunrise with three rays. Every medallion uses the same olive leaf wreath, painted-wood rim and small cream flower accent.
prompt_extra: exactly one centered emblem per cell, no text, no numbers, no bird characters; identical rim size and lighting; wide transparent padding; nothing crosses cell boundaries
